description: Build script for running rialto unittests, including functions for building targets, running tests, and generating coverage reports.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a command with subprocess.run, checks return code, and exits on error.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set environment variables, and orchestrate build and test processes.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Builds test executables using cmake and make, with optional coverage.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the test suites with optional filtering, valgrind, and coverage, handling errors accordingly.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs the valgrind command with appropriate options for leak checking and suppression.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage reports using lcov and genhtml, and writes statistics.
